outcome_evidence: The oven starts open at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot partially raises the door at frames 55–65, but it swings back open at frames 66–68, also visible in wrist_image. Following repositioning and another lift at frames 154–166, the door is visibly closed at frames 167–179 in image and left_ego_image. No damage or unrelated object disturbance is visible.

failure_annotations.explanation: After the robot raises the door partway at frames 55–65, the door reverses and swings down at frames 66–68, leaving the oven open through frame 75 in left_ego_image and image; wrist_image also shows the downward rotation. The initial closing action therefore fails to maintain its progress. The images do not establish whether the reversal results from slipping or deliberate release.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reposition at the door handle and maintain controlled support through the complete closing arc, then verify the door remains closed before withdrawing; no human intervention is visibly needed.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The door returns to its open position without visible damage, displaced contents, or meaningful damage to surrounding objects.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The oven remains upright and the open door remains accessible, allowing another attempt without environmental resetting or human intervention.
